content.short: Privy offers a simple, robust library to onboard all users to web3.
content.description: Privy makes it easy to add authentication flows in minutes, so you can reach every user on mobile and desktop, whether they have a wallet or not. It eliminates the fragility of wallet connectors and the burden of managing whether users are connected, on a particular chain, or using a specific wallet. With just a few lines of code, you can securely onboard all users, walleted or not, freeing you to focus on your core product and deliver a smooth, consistent onboarding experience across networks.
